title: VerificationPlan
description: Verification plan for the target repository: the test, compile, lint, and notes fields below. Place these fields directly as the tool input — no outer wrapper. Omit any step the repo does not support (e.g. omit 'compile' for an interpreted-only project).

test.description: Single command that runs the project's test suite. Prefer an invocation that emits JUnit-XML reports — declare the resulting report glob(s) in 'report_paths' with report_kind='junit-xml'.

name.description: Stable label for this step, e.g. 'test'.

argv.description: Exact argv passed to the sandbox. No shell metacharacters. Avoid log-suppressing flags that strip report-emitter output (e.g. mvn -q).

report_paths.description: Optional globs (relative to repo root) that match report files this command produces. Strongly prefer commands that emit reports — they give the verifier per-test counts and findings instead of just an exit code.

report_kind.description: Format of the files matched by 'report_paths'. Required when 'report_paths' is non-empty.

required.description: Whether a non-zero exit code with no parsed report should fail the verify gate. Default true.

compile.description: Optional compile / type-check step run separately from tests. Use for compiled languages where a clean compile is itself a verification signal (Java javac, TypeScript tsc --noEmit, Go vet). Omit for projects without a meaningful compile step (e.g. pure Python).

lint.description: Zero or more lint / static-analysis steps. Each step is independent and runs in declaration order. Prefer SARIF or Checkstyle XML output where the linter supports it.

required.description: Default true. Set false for advisory-only checks the gate should not block on.

notes.description: Free text the planner wants downstream consumers to see — caveats, missing flags the planner could not configure, repos where a category genuinely has no canonical command.
